svg.title: FEM_Solver data pipeline: ownership, copy semantics, and data flow
svg.desc: Horizontal pipeline diagram showing data ownership zones, what is passed by reference vs copied, and the flow from model through assembler to solution state
svg.text: Data flow law: all arrows point right, none point left
Zone A never receives writes. Zone B never stores state. Zone C written only by commitHistory(). Zone D append-only.
The Postprocessor consumes Zone D via SolutionSnapshot — it never touches Zone C or Zone B.
